_comment: Real weld photographs, used as eval fixtures so the weld-diagnosis tests are
not run against the manual's own artwork. Testing a system on its source
material is circular: the agent can recognise a crop of page 35 as a crop of
page 35, and score well without looking at anything.
All are freely licensed and credited below. not-a-weld-machine.webp is the
challenge repo's own product.webp, used as a negative control.

images.title: Roostevabaterase keevisõmblus (stainless steel weld seam)
images.author: Tanel Eensoo
images.usedFor: A real, evenly rippled bead. Tests that a sound weld is allowed to be sound.

images.title: Weld of flash-butt welding
images.author: Sergey82k
images.usedFor: A genuine weld made by a process this machine does not have. Tests that the agent engages without forcing it into one of the manual's six wire-weld panels.

images.title: TIG Weld low magnification
images.author: Dr. Crash (commonswiki)
images.usedFor: Held back from the scored set: it is an annotated micrograph with 'weld bead' and '~5 mm' printed on it, so it leaks its own answer.

images.title: BeadOnPlateTest
images.author: Dumontierc
images.usedFor: Held back from the scored set: 548x114 and too low-resolution to judge a bead profile from.

images.title: Vulcan OmniPro 220 product photo
images.author: Harbor Freight / prox-technologies
images.usedFor: Negative control. Shown the machine, the agent must decline to diagnose a weld rather than find a defect in it.
